app.title: The Rope Bridge
app.tagline: Alone is safe. Together you get wet.
app.bootFailed: Something went wrong. Most likely an old saved session is in the way.

lobby.headline: Who's crossing?
lobby.tooFew: With two of you there are planks to spare. Go find someone else.

modes.flagsHint: Planting a flag is public. Breaking your word is expensive.
modes.rottenHint: One plank breaks under a single person. Nobody knows which.
modes.weightsHint: Backpack 1–3: hand out more, drink more.
modes.fogHint: No talking. Just wind and ten seconds of silence.
modes.ropeHint: Once per session: swing across safely for one sip.

negotiation.headline: Talk it over. Or pretend to.
negotiation.ruleLine: Standing alone hands out {giving}. Two on one plank: both drink 2.
negotiation.deathZoneRule: Death zone: fewer planks than people. Standing alone hands out {giving}.

choose.headline: Your plank. Nobody sees it.
choose.weightRisk: Safe: hand out {giving} · Fall: drink {weight} × people
choose.autoPicked: Time's up — plank {plank} picked for you.
choose.tooltip: Alone on the plank = safe. Two of you = wet.

step.stageFailed: The canyon stays shut today. On to the result.

distribute.headline: {name} hands out
distribute.quickHeadline: The safe ones hand out 1 each

vulture: The plank was not the problem.

rules.headline: In three sentences
rules.card1Body: Everyone secretly picks a plank. You may talk first.
rules.card2Body: Stand alone and you hand out. Share a plank and you drink and fall.
rules.card3Body: Every peaceful round costs a plank. Eventually there aren't enough for anyone.

dialog.abortBody: This round's choices will be lost.

orientation.headline: Turn your phone upright
orientation.body: The canyon is deep, not wide.

share.pair: {a} and {b} fell together for the {count}. time 🌉

coach.negotiation: Talk about whatever you like. The choice comes next, in secret — and nobody has to keep their word.
coach.result: Every round without a fall costs the bridge one plank. At some point there is not enough for anyone.
